name: Admin Accounting Hostings
description: Superuser manages the client hosting registry at /panel/accounting/hostings: list with an inline estado select (Activo/Inactivo, PATCHes on change with snap-back), validity, 4 KPI cards (active count, monthly income, expiring in 30 days, historic total paid from list meta) and modal CRUD with per-modality payment defaults plus client billing contact fields (email, contact name, identification). Ciclos/total pagado are read-only in the form (computed from the cycle history). Since Aug 2026 Cliente renders the linked relation (client_display_name) instead of the free-text `Persona - Marca` label, and Proyecto is a column of its own.
